description: A reliability engineering manager must approve the remediation and customer-recovery plan after a production webhook queue delay, with input from an on-call SRE and a customer support lead.

shared_context.S1: Yesterday, the production webhook queue delayed deliveries for 35 minutes before the backlog was cleared.
shared_context.S2: Maya owns the final remediation plan and its operational commitments.
shared_context.S3: The current draft keeps the backlog alert at 50,000 queued events, retains replay data for 7 days, and includes no targeted customer-recovery action.
shared_context.S4: As part of the incident review routine, Maya checks with the on-call and customer-support owners before approving the final plan.

PF1.text: While examining queue metrics during a different alert-tuning task this morning, Owen confirmed that the backlog crossed 10,000 events 18 minutes before delivery latency became customer-visible; the current 50,000-event alert therefore pages too late, but he has not yet opened the tuning ticket.

PF2.text: While preparing follow-up cases, Clara confirmed that exactly two customers, Northstar Health and Lumen Retail, had delayed webhook deliveries covered by their support agreements and must receive a replay package and a direct incident notice; she has not added those cases to the incident record yet.

acceptance_conditions: The backlog alert threshold must be set to exactly 10,000 queued events.
A backlog-alert tuning commitment must be recorded.
Replay data retention must remain 7 days.
Replay must be provided to exactly Northstar Health and Lumen Retail.
Direct incident notices must be sent to exactly Northstar Health and Lumen Retail.
A customer-recovery commitment covering both named customers must be recorded.
The earlier 10,000-event warning threshold must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'customer_recovery' and c['target'] == 'Northstar Health,Lumen Retail' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The observed early-warning point changes the alert threshold from the draft's 50,000 events to exactly 10,000 and creates the need for an alert-tuning commitment.
The support-agreement confirmation changes customer recovery from no targeted action to replay and direct notices for exactly Northstar Health and Lumen Retail, with a named recovery commitment.
